name: DCS-BIOS (Skunkworks)
summary: Export.lua script that lets external hardware and software read and operate the clickable cockpits of DCS aircraft.
description:
DCS-BIOS is an `Export.lua` script that connects home cockpit hardware (e.g. Arduino panels) and software to the clickable cockpit of DCS aircraft. This is the DCS-Skunkworks continuation of the original, no longer updated, DCS-BIOS.

After installing, add this line to `Saved Games\DCS\Scripts\Export.lua` (create the file if it doesn't exist): `dofile(lfs.writedir()..[[Scripts\DCS-BIOS\BIOS.lua]])`. Hardpoint doesn't edit Export.lua because other tools share it.
